What to include

A few useful details can save time

Provide what you know; you do not need to diagnose the fault. Never remove a cover or approach unsafe wiring, gas or leaking hot water simply to take a photograph.

  • Suburb and property type
  • System type and approximate age
  • Fault, leak, upgrade or replacement goal
  • Household size and urgency
  • Any safe-to-observe error code

Email enquiries may also be sent to info@hotwaterorange.com.

Enquiries are delivered securely to the website owner for appropriate follow-up.
